methodology.title: How Reggie rates games
methodology.intro: Every game gets a rating out of 10 and a verdict. The final score never shows up.
methodology.epic: 8 and up. The rarest one: watch the whole thing.
methodology.mustWatch: 7 to 7.9. A really good game. Don't let it slip by.
methodology.worthIt: 5 to 6.9. A good watch if you have the time.
methodology.skip: Under 5. You can skip this one.
methodology.postIntro: Four criteria, computed from the game data.
methodology.suspenseText: The margin late in the game, lead changes, comebacks, overtime.
methodology.stakesText: Where both teams stand, rivalries, the playoffs and the NBA Cup.
methodology.preIntro: A promise, not a verdict: we rate what the matchup has to offer.
methodology.earlySeason: Early in the season, before 10 games, we leave form and standings out: too soon to read anything into them.
methodology.aiText: The numbers come from official game data. An AI writes the text from those numbers, with one simple rule: in Zero spoilers mode, nothing that gives away the result.
methodology.limitsText: A rating is still an opinion. A Worth it game between your two favorite teams might beat an Epic one for you: it's your replay.
